item.title: Morocco Ends Closed-Door Contracting for Mosque and Waqf Projects
item.description: A new decree forces Morocco’s religious endowment administration to open its construction and supply contracts to competitive, publicly advertised bidding for the first time, with mandatory online publication, set-asides for small businesses, and a complaint channel for bidders.
